efs2.1

Files, on Ethereum.

A fresh-genesis filesystem experiment

LOCAL CANDIDATE
Disposable development wallet · public, permanent bytes · native caller authority. This is not production or full EFS v2. Portable authorization, Lenses, tags, restore and directory moves are unintegrated.

Connecting to isolated chain…

NameKindRevisionAction
Add to this folder
Names: 1–64 printable ASCII bytes; percent sequences are literal. Representation selects a distinct exact Type, not a text schema.

Open a file

Exact bytes are verified against their immutable RecordId.

Convert preserves the opened payload; Save revision uses the text editor. Both retain all old revisions.
    

    Observation & contract interoperability
    A separately deployed consumer resolves canonical state. The demo seeds a producer quote; click to read and qualify its current value.
    Observations trust this RPC; they are not cryptographic state proofs.
    

    

    Actual gas. Modelled cost.
    MODEL · 11 Sep 2026 defaults, not live quotes. Execution-only estimates exclude real L2 data / sequencer fees. Anvil is not an L2 gas meter.
    Read-only receipt/effect reconciliation never resends. Deployment-scoped journal survives page reload in this browser.
